title: RAW a mixed material is called a simple element relative to the metals made from it
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Steele96 describes quicksilver as a watery/earthly mixture, then calls it matter of metals and therefore a simple element in respect of them. Preserve the same material, its constituents, its role in higher compounds and the explicit comparison-class restriction; do not infer purification into an absolutely simple substance.

design.mechanism: A source first attributes composition to one material, then uses that material's generative/component role to justify a classification restricted to a named product class. The explicit in respect of them points to the metals, while it retains quicksilver. Mixed composition and relative elementary role are different duties; their coexistence does not assert a material change. Adjacent95 distinguishes quicksilver as simple silver from compounded silver, while82 separately qualifies elemental simplicity.

design.contrast: R1: simple is an unrestricted assertion that quicksilver has no constituents. R2: simple denotes an achieved purification/transmutation after the earlier mixture description. R3: them refers to quicksilver's ingredients or to observers rather than to the metals. R4: material is element of itself or every arbitrary class. R5: the editor's compound/element explanation is substituted for a missing medieval clause.
design.prediction: A faithful account must retain quicksilver as the subject of both the mixture description and the restricted simple-element classification, with metals as the reference class justified by its being their matter. Removing or changing that reference class changes the claim. The source does not require quicksilver to lose its constituents before serving as matter of a metal, and its relative elementary role does not make it a fifth absolute member of the separate four-element list. Merely naming mercury, sulphur and metal does not preserve the argument.
design.scope: Source-only informed working hypothesis. No Voynich values, count map, causal decoder, target selection or new primitive requirement. Historical material theory is reported, not endorsed as modern chemistry. Planetary Mercury is a separate referent/domain from this quicksilver.

source_basis.quote2: And therefore it is said, that quicksilver and brimstone is the element, that is to wit matter, of which all melting metal is made. Quicksilver is matter of all metal, and therefore in respect of them it is a simple element.
source_basis.quote3: There are two manner of silvers, simple and compound. The simple is fleeting, and is called quicksilver
